title: 第140章 剿灭双龙寨第139章 斩杀大当家
lines: 一众山匪眼神期待，静待烟尘消散。
烟尘消散后，银色月光下，场中坐着一道身影。
“大当家的？”
“大……不是大当家！”
“怎么可能，大当家被杀了！”
山匪们看清盘坐恢复的是戴着面具的楚生，不禁惊恐起来，眼神中充满震惊与不可置信。
“大哥！你杀了我大哥！你该死！”二当家早已服用丹药，此刻恢复不少，看到亲大哥脑袋滚落在地，而对方还在打坐恢复，怎会让楚生安心恢复，顿时暴怒起来，朝着楚生冲了上去。
“去死！”
楚生睁开眼，弹射而起，一刀斩出，爆发出破开一切的力量。
“破风刀！”
楚生彻底放开手脚，一刀便将二当家脑袋砍掉。
楚生摸了二当家的乾坤袋，便将刀口转向其他山匪。
“大人，放过我，我是被逼上山寨。”
“大人，我从未杀过人，求你放过我。”
“大人，放过我们吧！我们都是无辜的。”
山匪们见到大当家和二当家都被楚生所杀，一个个连忙丢下兵器，跪地求饶，痛哭流涕。
楚生见状，脸色平静，淡淡道：“不好意思，我接的任务是屠灭双龙寨，你们只有一条路。”
“什么路？”山匪们看到一线生机，连忙问道。
刀光骤然飞旋，刀芒频出，一个个山匪殒命于巨陨刀下，楚生淡淡道：
“死路！”
一众山匪反应不及，一盏茶功夫，现场便只剩下满地尸体。
月光照耀下，场地中流淌的鲜血泛着银光，空气中飘着晶莹的血雾。
楚生擦拭巨陨刀上的血迹，寒声道：“里面的人都出来，三息之内还未出来，全部斩杀！”
“大人，饶命，我们这就出来……”厢房内传出恐惧的声音。
一道道干瘦的身影从厢房内，连滚带爬窜出来。
一个个衣衫褴褛，一看就是营养不良，一看到楚生便连忙跪了下来。
脑袋沉沉埋在地上，四肢撑在血泊中，身体惶恐地颤抖。
“大人，饶命啊！”
“大人，我们是被抓来山寨的，不是山贼，从来没做过坏事……”
楚生没有回应，保持着沉默，静待所有人出来。
还有之前那些面容姣好的女子，也从中走出，一个个被吓得哭哭啼啼。
content_en:
The bandits looked expectantly, waiting for the smoke and dust to dissipate.
After the smoke and dust dissipated, under the silver moonlight, a figure sat in the field.
"The boss?"
"The big...is not the big boss!"
"How is it possible? The boss was killed!"
When the bandits saw clearly that it was Chu Sheng who was sitting cross-legged and recovering, they couldn't help but panic, their eyes full of shock and disbelief.
"Brother! You killed my eldest brother! You deserve to die!" The second master had already taken the elixir and was recovering a lot. When he saw his eldest brother's head rolling to the ground while the other party was still meditating to recover, how could Chu Sheng recover with peace of mind? He suddenly became furious and rushed towards Chu Sheng.
"Go to hell!"
Chu Sheng opened his eyes, shot up, slashed out with a knife, and exploded with power that broke through everything.
"Wind-breaking knife!"
Chu Sheng completely let go of his hands and feet and chopped off the second master's head with one knife.
Chu Sheng touched the second master's Qiankun bag and then turned his knife to the other bandits.
"Sir, please let me go. I was forced to go to the mountain stronghold."
"Sir, I have never killed anyone, please let me go."
"Sir, please let us go! We are all innocent."
When the bandits saw that the first and second masters had been killed by Chu Sheng, they all quickly dropped their weapons, knelt down and begged for mercy, crying bitterly.
When Chu Sheng saw this, his face was calm and he said calmly: "I'm sorry, my mission is to kill Shuanglong Village, and you only have one way."
"What way?" The bandits saw a glimmer of hope and asked quickly.
The sword light suddenly whirled, the sword light flashed out frequently, one by one the bandits died under the giant meteor sword, Chu Sheng said lightly:
"Dead end!"
The bandits were unable to react in time, and within a moment of tea, only corpses were left on the scene.
Under the moonlight, the blood flowing in the venue glowed with silver, and a crystal mist of blood floated in the air.
Chu Sheng wiped the blood on the giant meteor knife and said in a cold voice: "Everyone inside comes out. If they don't come out within three breaths, kill them all!"
"Sir, spare your life, we'll come out right now..." A fearful voice came from the side room.
Thin figures rolled out from the side room one after another.
All of them were in ragged clothes and looked malnourished. As soon as they saw Chu Sheng, they quickly knelt down.
His head was buried heavily on the ground, his limbs were propped up in a pool of blood, and his body was shaking in fear.
"Sir, please spare my life!"
"Sir, we were captured and brought to the village. We are not bandits. We have never done anything bad..."
Chu Sheng did not respond and remained silent, waiting for everyone to come out.
The beautiful women from before also walked out of it, all of them crying with fear.
title_en: Chapter 140: Destroying Shuanglong Village Chapter 139: Killing the Boss
